controller.activation: SDL joystick/gamecontroller hotplug events are received but explicitly discarded; no SDL_JoystickOpen/SDL_GameControllerOpen call exists in the event loop, so the Anbernic RG CubeXX pad never becomes a usable input source and only SDL_KEYDOWN/SDL_KEYUP reach the engine's KeyboardEvent path.
controller.bindings: Not applicable: no joystick axis/button/hat index table is read by the engine, so the device's 4 axes / 17 buttons / 1 hat (per the observed sdl_mapping, e.g. b:b3 a:b4 leftx:a0 lefty:a1 dpup:h0.1) cannot be wired without adding new input code.
controller.notes: This is a keyboard/mouse-only input engine as currently written. The Anbernic controller is enumerated by SDL (SDL_JOYDEVICEADDED fires) but framework.cpp's switch statement intentionally no-ops that case, so the control pad produces zero in-game effect. Faithfully adding controller support would require implementing SDL_GameControllerOpen/SDL_JOYAXISMOTION/SDL_JOYBUTTONDOWN handling mapped to the engine's existing key bindings -- a nontrivial, game-specific change we are not making here to avoid altering engine behavior with a lossy stand-in. Reporting unsupported rather than claiming native support.
